# Brief: review round 1, analyst

Repository: `~/Desktop/projects/gulfstream-delivery-nowcast`. Output: `docs/build/review1_analyst.md`. Write only your output file; never edit the repository. A finding has an id, a file and line, a severity (blocking, major or minor), evidence (a quote or command output), and a concrete fix. No evidence, no finding. Default to wrong under doubt: when you cannot confirm something reads right, report it.

Act as an aerospace and defense equity research associate with five minutes. Read the note's PDF (`output/GD_research_note.pdf`; page images are in `.build/shots/note/page-NN.png`), the workbook (`output/gd_gulfstream_model.xlsx`, read with `.venv/bin/python` and openpyxl), `output/charts/dashboard.png`, the phone shots `.build/shots/phone_light.png` and `phone_dark.png`, `docs/LINKEDIN_POST.md` and `docs/INTERVIEW_NOTES.md`. Name the three weakest things, each with a fix, and every claim that outruns the evidence. The project's own framing (§2 of `~/Desktop/prompt library/gulfstream-delivery-nowcast/GULFSTREAM_NOWCAST_PROMPT.md`) is that the backtest shows tracking after the fact, and only locked quarters test timeliness. Time box: 35 minutes.
